Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects toolpath geometry and part protection.

- Boundary extension keeps standing part material outside the added cutting area.
- An inward offset still causes a gouge finding and prevents posting.
- MCP generate and verify show the notes for uncut stock corners.
- The change meets the requirements of issue #2438. No UI files or NC/CL goldens changed. No screenshots are required.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream main `b48c658282deae26e765e787a3c7b7b5ef98a71f`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build of the nine selected app test suites | Pass |
| adaptive_zero_margin_island | 4 passed |
| keep_law | 31 passed |
| area_controls | 13 passed |
| area_overhead | 1 passed |
| adaptive_pinch | 1 passed; 1 existing heavy test ignored |
| narrow_band | 2 passed |
| setup_align_2d_area | 5 passed |
| mcp_generate | 2 passed |
| mcp_verify | 3 passed |
| motion machining2d::unreached::law | 4 passed |
| Clippy, app and motion, all targets, -D warnings | Pass |

I repeated two mutations in the local review worktree:

1. Restored upstream main's `boundary_ctx.rs`. All three extension tests failed with gouge findings.
2. Restored upstream main's `script/api.rs`. The default corner test failed with `generate exposes op notes`.

I restored both files. All four tests in `adaptive_zero_margin_island` then passed again. No mutation edits remain.

Requested changes: none.

Scope: selected local tests only. The release gate, heavy tests, and UI snapshots were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: aa13a6f3e25ea7aeda6ef6d20c19d14ea0345455 -->
**Verdict: no blockers**

Second review (read-only, Opus) under the safety floor. I read the diff against `origin/main` and the code around it at the head. I did not use the result of the other review.

## 1. Gouge

- The change sets `AreaCtx::blocked` for `SrcRef::Entity` and `SrcRef::Stock` (`crates/app/src/operation/boundary_ctx.rs:146-170`). `islands` stays `false`.
- In `boundary::resolve`, `blocked` is used at three places only. Line 283 (extension) now subtracts it. Line 302 (island closure) and line 364 (Face/Finish `forbidden`) do not change, because `islands` is `false` and the family is `Clearing`. `reach_past_edge` (containment Outside) uses the same identity closure, so it does not change.
- The extension result is `connected_to(area ∪ (reach − blocked), area)`. This is a subset of the result before the change. The change can only remove area, so it cannot make a new tool-centre position. The generator then erodes the region by the tool radius (`Native::ToolInside`), so the cutter stays at least R (+ stock to leave) from the `blocked` boundary.
- `blocked` uses the same ladder as the region itself: `ladder_planes(t - oz, stock_top(...), b - oz, stepdown)` with the same `stock_top` inputs as `whole_model_pocket` (`area.rs:178-184`) and `stock_pocket` (`area.rs:225-236`). `material_overhead` also includes the shadow of material above each plane. Thus `blocked` contains each island hole of the region, and it does not skip small islands (`minus_standing` skips islands below `ISLAND_AREA_MIN`). This is the safe direction.
- The 3+2 frame: `blocked` is built from local facets with local planes, as the region is. The yaw path rotates `blocked` (`wcs_yaw.rs:281`).
- Cases checked: an offset into the part (positive `offset`) still makes a gouge that `DepthLaw::Keep` / verify refuse, as before (the `a_whole_model_area_offset_into_the_part_*` pins stay). A negative stock to leave moves the cutter nearer by that value only, as the user asked. An island that touches the boundary is a notch, and `reach − blocked` keeps the notch. When `fold_height` gives `None`, `blocked` is `None` and the behaviour is the same as before (verify refuses the gouge). `SrcRef::Selection` does not change.

## 2. Leftover note

- `unreached_corners` is a morphological opening: `piece − (piece ⊖ reach) ⊕ reach`, clipped to the stock outline. It finds the convex stock corners and also a narrow neck in a reached piece. This only adds notes.
- The note is computed only when `cleared_around` is true (the old band-note condition). No refusal changed or became a note. The change of `keep_law.rs` tests from `refused` to `stays_clear` is correct: the extension does not gouge now. The offset gouge pins still hold the refusal law.
- The stock clip uses `stock_region` (no frame) or the projected stock in the local frame. Corners in the extended air are excluded correctly. When no stock is known, no clip is applied, which can only add notes.

## 3. Numeric safety

- `reach` is guarded by `is_finite() && > 0`. Empty regions and slivers give an empty result (`connected_pieces` drops pieces with area below `PIECE_AREA_MIN` or thinner than `SLIVER_HALF_WIDTH`). The unit tests cover NaN and an empty region.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests.

## 4. Tests

- Without the `boundary_ctx.rs` change, `blocked` is `None`. The extension then floods the island and verify reports a gouge, so the three `extension_*` pins fail. Without the `api.rs` change, `notes` is missing, so `zero_margin_adaptive_around_island_names_uncut_stock_corners` fails. The mutation runs in the PR body agree.
- `extension_with_top_allowance_keeps_island_untouched_and_clears_corners` measures the keep-out: each feed chord below Z 15 has a centre distance of at least `R - chord_sag - 0.05` from the island. It also checks zero gouge cells and that the program posts. The MCP pins check `gouge.cells == 0` and `rest.max < 0.05`.
- The Gate map line is in the new test file. No golden changed.

## Non-blocking findings

1. `crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs:105-111`: when the corner check gives `Err`, the code only writes a `tracing::warn`. The band check above it also pushes a note ("the check ... did not run"). Material can then stay with no note to the user. Recommend the same note as the band check. Follow-up `P7`.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2955-2975` adds 17 lines to a file of about 3,860 lines, and `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` grows to 439 lines. The `narrow_stock` selection could move into `keep_law.rs`. This file was over the 400-line limit before the change.
3. `op_view` now adds a `"notes"` array to each operation row that has notes (`generate`, `verify`), also for older notes (bands, break-through). The key is additive. The `camcraft-mcp` skill does not list it yet.
4. The module doc of `crates/motion/src/machining2d/unreached.rs` describes only erosion (#1655). It does not mention the opening that #2438 adds. Recommend one more sentence in the provenance text.
5. `CORNER_HALF_WIDTH = 0.03` mm also hides a real cusp at an obtuse stock corner (for example 150 deg with R 5 leaves about 0.18 mm deep). This is near the tolerance level, and the decision file gives the reason. I record it only.

Read from the diff. Not built.
